restaurantName: Broome Park Golf and Country Club
bio: Enjoy an exquisite afternoon tea in the delightful setting of a 17th century country house in Canterbury. Where better to dine than a fine 17th country house set within the 235 acres of the beautiful Kent countryside?  This Afternoon Tea experience is not only set in a stunning rural location but the dining room itself has been exceptionally restored to match the Jacobean mansion. Your menu is created from the finest local ingredients and overlooks the grandeur of the Broome Park.
pageTitle: Broome Park Golf and Country Club
